overall_reason: The update introduces ConfChangeV2 / joint consensus (incoming+outgoing voter sets, LearnersNext, AutoLeave), Changer-based applyConfChange (demotion allowed, removal of unknown peer ignored, removing last voter rejected), raft-initiated auto-leave entries appended inside Advance, and RawNode/Node Ready/Advance refactoring. Most old properties stay as requirements but their observers/helpers (config record, Members, Won, ConfigOf, ConfKinds) must migrate to a joint representation, otherwise identical predicate text silently checks only the incoming majority. Semantic edits: EffectContract (demotion becomes required behaviour; raft-generated auto-leave entries are a legitimate id=0 origin), AckPreservation_LogUnchanged (impl-abstraction clause: Advance may now append exactly one auto-leave entry), ConfigurationTransitionSafety (joint voters; bootstrap exemption narrowed so auto-leave entries are checked), QuorumAccounting (joint majority). New obligations: one pending conf change also for raft-generated auto-leave entries, and quorum-overlap of every applied configuration transition. Several suspected implementation defects must stay visible (V2 entries not counted by numOfPendingConf; auto-leave not bumping pendingConfIndex; restore/newRaft ignore joint ConfState fields). Executed evidence (60 checks, 59 TLC old/new evaluations + 22 helper checks, 13 Go observations) confirmed every initial decision; only the overlap expression was refined. Three suspected implementation defects were reproduced in the new code (G2, G4, G7) and are left visible: the proposed properties reject them.

entries.final_expression_tla:
CampaignContract(o) ==
    LET tick==o.trigger="Tick"
        due==~tick \/ (o.role#"Leader" /\ o.elapsed+1>=o.timeout)
        cfg==[voters |-> o.voters, outgoing |-> o.outgoing]
        allVoters==o.voters\cup o.outgoing
        ignore==~due \/ o.role="Leader" \/ o.node\notin allVoters
        badSlice==~ignore /\ o.applied+1<o.first
        pending==\E k\in (o.applied+1)..o.commit:o.hist[k].kind\in ConfKinds
        blocked==ignore \/ pending \/ badSlice
        singleton==JointWon(cfg,{o.node})
        expected==IF blocked \/ singleton THEN {} ELSE
            {[from |-> o.node,to |-> n,type |-> IF o.pre THEN "MsgPreVote" ELSE "MsgVote",
              term |-> o.term+1,index |-> Len(o.hist),
              logTerm |-> IF o.hist= <<>> THEN 0 ELSE o.hist[Len(o.hist)].term,
              forced |-> FALSE,count |-> 1]:n\in allVoters\{o.node}}
    IN /\ o.voteRequests=expected
       /\ IF tick /\ o.role="Leader" THEN o.afterTerm=o.term
          ELSE IF badSlice THEN o.fatal="Hup unapplied slice compacted"
          ELSE IF blocked THEN o.afterRole=o.role /\ o.afterTerm=o.term
          ELSE /\ o.fatal=""
               /\ o.afterRole=IF singleton THEN "Leader" ELSE IF o.pre THEN "PreCandidate" ELSE "Candidate"
               /\ o.afterTerm=o.term+(IF ~o.pre \/ singleton THEN 1 ELSE 0)
